title: Recruitment module registered for APES CIC
summary: Registers the first-party Recruitment plugin on APES CIC only, with hub navigation and permission abilities, so staff can open a stub recruitment surface while role CRUD and the public board land in follow-up releases.
changes: Add the recruitment module type to the first-party registry, compatible and shipped only on APES CIC.
Ship abilities for view-own, view-all, create, update, delete, and review-applications with the same default role matrix pattern as sibling modules.
Wire APES CIC hub navigation to a stub recruitment index so View and Create quick links resolve.
Update the module runtime contract and agent planning docs for the v0.34.x Recruitment milestone.
version_rationale: Minor release: first backward-compatible Recruitment capability on the v0.34.x line (registry, permissions, and hub entry) without public apply or staff role CRUD yet.
validation: PHPUnit ModuleRegistryTest, ModuleInstallationSynchronizationTest, ModuleRollbackCompatibilityTest, ModuleStateMiddlewareTest, ModuleAdministrationAndNavigationTest, ServiceHubQuickLinksTest, ModuleProviderContractTest, ModuleLifecycleTest, and JobRoleCapabilityPacksTest pass for the expanded catalogue.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: RecruitmentRole CRUD, the public roles board, and application review are not included; those ship in later 0.34.x patches.
Recruitment is not available on Shelter or Pet Care Clinic sub-cores.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the recruitment registry entry, permissions, and APES CIC hub stub.
provenance: Recruitment module scaffold and APES CIC registration for issues #212 and #219, pull request #241.
